name: Turof
description: Turof is one of the Arch realms of Atlas, described as a little cousin of La-rel with a similarly magical atmosphere. The party has not knowingly visited Turof, and its keystone remains unassigned. Until a future keeper takes the mantle, Kit Anger and the DM are responsible for stewarding Turof’s keystone.
